articles.title: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub
articles.snippet: Industry leaders debate whether digital dollar wallets will dismantle traditional bank accounts or simply modernize the underlying infrastructure.

articles.title: Ethereum commits to letting users pay gas fees without having to hold ETH
articles.snippet: The Frame Transactions feature was locked into the Hegotá upgrade last month, and Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin says the work has moved quickly since.

articles.title: Once-hyped Ethereum rival Harmony wants to shut its blockchain over AI threats
articles.snippet: Developers want to voluntarily shut down the network, saying state actors and AI agents have made security too difficult, then redirect ONE emissions into an AI video business.

articles.title: Ukrainian police took down a crypto scam that stole up to $1 million a month
articles.snippet: Investigators have identified 62 victims and say more than 46 Ukrainians took part in the alleged operation.

articles.title: Timing the bitcoin market is exciting but nearly impossible. Here's why
articles.snippet: A historical analysis of bitcoin price performance from 2010 through 2026 demonstrates that the vast majority of the asset's annual returns occur during a tiny fraction of the calendar year.
